name: Dashboard is responsive on mobile viewport
description: When viewed on a mobile device (375px width), the dashboard displays a hamburger menu and stacked card layout.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page and log in as manager
Resize the browser viewport to 375px width
Verify the navigation collapses into a hamburger menu icon
Verify the navigation menu expands showing all navigation links
Verify the dashboard statistics cards are stacked vertically
